from pathlib import Path
import sys
ROOT = Path('.').resolve()
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))
from research.semantic_integration.runtime_v0.world import ConstructionWorld

world = ConstructionWorld.open(ROOT / 'world' / 'world.sqlite')
rows = world.query_semantic("""
SELECT t.vessel_id, SUM(jc.charge) AS total_established_charges
FROM tow_job t
JOIN job_charge jc ON jc.job_id = t.job_id
GROUP BY t.vessel_id
ORDER BY t.vessel_id
""")
world.close()
tasks.unresolved_handling: Only jobs with an established charge in job_charge are summed. Jobs J5, J6, and J7 have no job_charge row (billing_outcome status insufficient_evidence) and are excluded from totals rather than treated as zero.

from pathlib import Path
import sys
ROOT = Path('.').resolve()
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))
from research.semantic_integration.runtime_v0.world import ConstructionWorld

world = ConstructionWorld.open(ROOT / 'world' / 'world.sqlite')
total = world.query_semantic("""
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(jc.charge), 0) AS total_established_charges
FROM tow_job t
JOIN job_charge jc ON jc.job_id = t.job_id
WHERE t.berth = 'B12'
""")
unresolved = world.query_semantic("""
SELECT t.job_id, t.vessel_id, bo.status AS billing_status, bo.reason
FROM tow_job t
JOIN billing_outcome bo ON bo.job_id = t.job_id
WHERE t.berth = 'B12' AND bo.status = 'insufficient_evidence'
ORDER BY t.job_id
""")
world.close()
